question: Should OpenClaw add read-only recursive/depth mode to the existing `subagents` tool and `/subagents list`, or wait for broader session-chain/tree APIs?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the request changes public model-facing and slash-command semantics and must preserve subagent control boundaries while aligning with adjacent hierarchy work.

options.title: Add read-only depth listing
options.body: Add explicit `depth`/`recursive` listing with flattened descendant rows and parent/depth metadata while leaving mutation targets direct-scoped by default.

options.title: Fold into chain/tree work
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on #11040 or #54578 so OpenClaw has one canonical hierarchy API instead of parallel listing surfaces.

options.title: Decline recursive core listing
options.body: Document direct-child visibility plus descendant counts as the intended model and direct users to explicit status files or future plugin/UI surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add read-only depth listing
recommendation.body: Add explicit `depth`/`recursive` listing with flattened descendant rows and parent/depth metadata while leaving mutation targets direct-scoped by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the nested subagent and `subagents` tool surface that the product/API decision would extend.
